declaration.preface: Anupam Rasayan India Limited (ARIL), established in 1984, is a leading manufacturer of life science–related specialty chemicals.
declaration.declaration:
We are committed to upholding and promoting the principles of human rights, ethical labour practices, and inclusive growth across all levels of our organization.

Through respect for human dignity, fair employment, and equal opportunity, we aim to create a workplace built on integrity, safety, and respect. This policy aligns with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs), ILO Core Conventions, UN Global Compact Principles, and the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), reinforcing our commitment to responsible and sustainable business conduct.
declaration.scope:
This Human Rights and Labour Standards Policy apply to all Anupam Rasayan India Limited facilities, employees, contract workers, apprentices, suppliers, contractors, and stakeholders associated with the company’s operations and value chain.

It covers all business functions, including manufacturing, research and development, procurement, logistics, and community engagements, ensuring ethical, fair, and safe working conditions. The policy also extends to subsidiaries, joint ventures, and third-party service providers, promoting consistent adherence to international human rights and labour standards across the organization.

focusAreas: Child Labour, Forced Labour, and Human Trafficking

Employee Health and Safety: Employee Health and Safety: We prioritize the health, safety, and well-being of every employee and contract worker by maintaining a zero-harm culture across all operations. Stringent occupational health and safety (OHS) standards, risk assessments, and emergency preparedness programs are implemented at all sites. Regular safety audits, training sessions, and continuous improvement measures are undertaken to ensure compliance with the Factories Act, 1948, and ISO 45001 standards.
Working Conditions: Working Conditions: We are dedicated to providing a professional, respectful, and fair working environment. All employees and contract workers receive fair wages, regulated working hours, and access to welfare facilities in line with applicable labour laws. Our commitment to decent work ensures job security, safe workspaces, and equitable treatment for all.
Social Dialogue: Social Dialogue: We recognize the importance of transparent communication between management and employees to promote mutual trust and collaboration. Anupam Rasayan respects the right of employees to form or join associations and participate in collective bargaining. Through structured dialogues, suggestion programs, and open grievance channels, we ensure that employee voices are heard and valued.
Career Management and Training: Career Management and Training: We are committed to empowering our workforce through continuous learning, professional development, and skill enhancement. Tailored training programs on technical, managerial, and sustainability topics are conducted regularly to support career progression and leadership growth. Equal access to training and performance-based promotions ensures a culture of merit and opportunity.
Child Labour, Forced Labour, and Human T: Child Labour, Forced Labour, and Human Trafficking: Anupam Rasayan maintains a strict zero-tolerance policy towards the use of child labour, forced labour, bonded labour, or any form of human trafficking. All employment and contractor engagements undergo mandatory age and identity verification. Suppliers and partners are required to adhere to the same standards through our supplier code of conduct and periodic compliance audits.
Discrimination and Harassment: Discrimination and Harassment: We foster an inclusive, equitable, and discrimination-free workplace. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and performance. The company enforces a zero-tolerance policy toward harassment, bullying, or discrimination of any kind. An Internal Complaints Committee (ICC), in accordance with the POSH Act, 2013, ensures timely and confidential resolution of grievances.
External Stakeholder Human Rights: External Stakeholder Human Rights: Anupam Rasayan respects the rights and well-being of external stakeholders, including local communities, business partners, and customers. We engage transparently with surrounding communities to minimize operational impacts on health, safety, and livelihoods. Our community initiatives focus on education, healthcare, and social welfare, contributing to inclusive and sustainable local development.

policy.reviewMechanism:
The Sustainability Committee, in coordination with the Human Resources, Ethics and Compliance, and EHS Departments, shall be responsible for conducting the annual review of this Human Rights and Labour Standards Policy. The review will assess the policy’s effectiveness, progress toward established human rights and labour targets, and compliance with applicable legal and organizational requirements.

Any updates or revisions resulting from operational changes, new regulations, audit findings, or stakeholder feedback will be reviewed and approved by the Board of Directors. The revised policy will be communicated across all sites and value chain partners to ensure continued alignment with Anupam Rasayan’s corporate values, sustainability commitments, and international human rights standards.
